name: AdAttributionKit re-engagement conversions
plain: Measures whether an ad brought an existing user back into the app.
meaning: SKAN could only count new installs. Re-engagement attribution lets advertisers measure retargeting without an IDFA.

ios.api_surface: AdAttributionKit re-engagement via universal link or URL with conversion tag
ios.note: Before iOS 18.4 only one re-engagement window could be active at a time; 18.4 allows overlapping windows through conversion tags.

limits.headline: Can count whether an ad brought you back to an app you already have, on iPhone
limits.user_action: You tap an ad, then open the app you already installed
can: Tell the advertiser an ad led you to reopen the app
Count it without an ad ID
Work with overlapping windows from iOS 18.4
cannot: Name you or give your device ID in the report
Report right away; there are delays
Work on Android; there is no matching feature
Run more than one window at a time before iOS 18.4
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 17.4 and later). Android has no equivalent.

story.what_it_is: Apple's way to measure whether an ad brought an existing user back into an app.

marketing.name: AdAttributionKit
marketing.pitch: Measure installs and re-engagement with privacy preserving reports.

story.for_you: You tap an ad for an app you already have and it opens. Apple quietly counts that the ad worked, without telling the advertiser who you are.
story.for_makers: Old SKAdNetwork could only count new installs. Re-engagement lets advertisers measure retargeting campaigns, so they can win back lapsed users without the IDFA.

use_cases.example: A lapsed player sees 'come back and get a free pack' and returning is counted for the campaign.
A shopper taps a sale ad for an app they have and the retailer sees that the ad led to a return.
A promo for a free ride makes a dormant rider open the app, and the ad network gets the credit.
A streaming service measures how many ads brought back cancelled subscribers.
An ad network reports re-engagement conversions in coarse values after delays.
A growth team compares the lift from a re-engagement campaign against a control group.

story.android_note: The Android counterpart for re-engagement was part of the retired Attribution Reporting plan.

technical_bounds: Uses the app's open link to carry the tag
